name: build_canonical_code_table
description: Reads a symbol count and then one code length per symbol. It builds lookup entries for each code length from one to sixteen, storing a bit mask, a code value and a length for every matching symbol.

name: open_use_and_close_library
description: Part of the IFF library: it opens another library through exec-style calls, calls two of that library's functions, closes it and returns the code five.

name: init_node_and_empty_list
description: Part of the IFF library: stores its address argument in a node structure, calls a library function and saves its result, then initialises an empty list header inside the node so that it points to itself.

name: allocate_and_queue_task_node
description: Part of the IFF library: when a preceding condition holds, it allocates a memory block, records the current task pointer in it, clears a field and adds the block to a list. It then increments a counter in the structure and clears a status bit.

name: release_node_when_unused
description: Part of the IFF library: removes a node from its list and frees its memory when the condition holds, then decrements the node's counter. When the counter reaches zero and a pending flag is set, it calls a further routine and returns its result.

name: free_node_or_mark_pending
description: Part of the IFF library: when the node's counter is zero, it removes the node from its list, frees it and returns the value stored in it. Otherwise it sets the pending flag bit and returns zero.

name: remove_and_free_node_value
description: Part of the IFF library: removes a node from its list, frees its memory block and returns the value stored at offset 34 in the node.

name: read_form_chunk_header
description: Part of the IFF library: reads an IFF chunk header through library file calls and checks its tag against the four-byte FORM signature. On a match it allocates a buffer, stores the chunk size and copies the header into it; it returns null when a check or the allocation fails.

name: read_form_chunk_header
description: Part of the IFF library: reads an IFF chunk header through library file calls and checks its tag against the four-byte FORM signature. On a match it allocates a buffer, stores the chunk size and copies the header into it; it returns null when a check or the allocation fails.

name: allocate_form_chunk_with_params
description: Part of the IFF library: if the tag equals the FORM signature, it allocates a buffer, stores the chunk size, the tag and two parameter values in it, and returns the buffer. Error codes report a failed allocation, a failed file call or a wrong tag.

name: allocate_chunk_record_with_params
description: Part of the IFF library: allocates a chunk record, stores the size, the tag and two parameter values in it, and returns the record pointer. It returns null with error codes when the allocation or the file call fails.

name: write_chunk_tag_and_params
description: Part of the IFF library: stores a tag value at the start of a buffer and writes it out through the file write call. On success it stores the tag and two parameter values after it, then calls one more file routine; a failed write returns error code 17 instead.

name: store_tag_and_two_params
description: Part of the IFF library: writes three 32-bit values into the buffer at the address register, the tag first and then two parameters, and then closes the file.

name: forward_single_library_call
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one library routine and returns.

name: free_memory_if_nonnull
description: Part of the IFF library: frees the memory block whose address is in the A1 register when that address is non-null, then calls one more routine.

name: find_chunk_by_tag
description: Part of the IFF library: walks the chunks inside a buffer, each with a tag and a size, stepping to the next chunk by its padded size. It returns the chunk whose tag matches the data register value, or null if no chunk matches.

name: return_helper_result_plus_eight
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one routine and returns its result plus eight.

name: unpack_three_bytes_to_words
description: Part of the IFF library: reads a block through a helper and converts each group of three bytes into one 16-bit word, combining the first byte shifted up four bits, the second byte and the high nibble of the third byte with bitwise OR. It returns the number of words produced, or zero when the helper gives nothing.

name: decode_ilbm_bitplane_rows
description: Part of the IFF library: checks the ILBM form type tag, reads the bitmap header fields and decodes rows through a per-row helper. The helper is selected by the compression byte, and running sums are kept in a four-word table.

name: copy_bytes_counted
description: Part of the IFF library: copies a run of bytes from the source address register to the destination address register, with the count taken from the data register plus one.

name: unpack_packbits_run_stream
description: Part of the IFF library: decodes a PackBits-style run stream. A negative control byte repeats the next byte that many times plus one, while a non-negative control byte copies the following bytes literally, until the output count in the data register is used up.

name: forward_single_library_call
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one library routine and returns.

name: write_ilbm_image_file
description: Part of the IFF library: opens a file for writing and writes an ILBM image. It writes the FORM, ILBM and BMHD headers with the bitmap fields, encodes the image data with or without compression, and writes the BODY chunk tag; a failed step closes the file and returns the error.

name: finish_chunk_with_size_patch
description: Part of the IFF library: checks that the written length is aligned to four bytes, seeks back to the chunk size field and writes the length there, then closes the file.

name: close_file_if_open
description: Part of the IFF library: closes the file handle when the handle in the data register is non-zero, then calls one more routine.

name: write_bitplane_rows_encoded
description: Part of the IFF library: writes rows of image data, computing the size of each row from the bitmap fields and writing it with the file write call. It returns the total byte count, or the write error code when a write fails.

name: write_rows_and_sum_counts
description: Part of the IFF library: writes rows of image data like its neighbour, but also adds a value returned by a helper into a running total on each write. It returns that total, or the write error code when a write fails.

name: pack_bytes_packbits_style
description: Part of the IFF library: compresses a byte stream into PackBits-style runs. Repeated bytes of three or more are written as a repeat run, and other bytes are gathered into literal runs of up to 128 bytes, each prefixed by a control byte.

name: pack_bytes_packbits_style
description: Part of the IFF library: compresses a byte stream into PackBits-style runs. Repeated bytes of three or more are written as a repeat run, and other bytes are gathered into literal runs of up to 128 bytes, each prefixed by a control byte.

name: pack_bytes_packbits_style
description: Part of the IFF library: compresses a byte stream into PackBits-style runs. Repeated bytes of three or more are written as a repeat run, and other bytes are gathered into literal runs of up to 128 bytes, each prefixed by a control byte.

name: count_repeat_run_length
description: Part of the IFF library: counts how many consecutive bytes equal the first byte, up to 128 bytes and no further than the end address, and leaves the scan position in the address registers.

name: find_node_for_current_task
description: Part of the IFF library: gets the current task and walks a list in the structure, returning the first node whose stored task pointer matches it, or null if none does.

name: clear_field_return_one
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one routine and, when the condition it leaves is not set, clears a field in the structure. It then returns one.

name: store_field_return_zero
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one routine, stores the input value in a field of the structure when that value is non-zero, and returns zero.

name: take_field_value_if_set
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one routine. If it returns zero, the result is minus one; otherwise it returns the value stored at offset 18 in the structure and clears that field.

name: return_minus_one
description: Part of the IFF library: returns the constant minus one and does nothing else.

name: read_flags_field_from_helper
description: Part of the IFF library: calls one routine and returns the longword at offset eight of the structure it gives back. The other branch in the pseudo-code is never taken.

name: combine_flags_with_depth_check
description: Part of the IFF library: calls a routine to get a value and, when a condition from it is clear, calls another routine and sets bit 11 of the result if the byte at offset eight of the structure is greater than five.

name: compute_mode_flags_from_dimensions
description: Part of the IFF library: builds a flags word from two 16-bit values in the address register. It sets the top bit when the first value exceeds 384 and a byte is below five, and sets bit two when the second value exceeds 279.

name: allocate_node_and_store_argument
description: Part of the disk font library: allocates a node through a library call, stores its argument at offset 34 of the node, calls a second library function on it, and returns whether the node was created.

name: allocate_node_and_store_argument
description: Part of the disk font library: allocates a node through a library call, stores its argument at offset 34 of the node, calls a second library function on it, and returns whether the node was created.

name: open_dos_and_graphics_libraries
description: Part of the disk font library: opens the dos and graphics libraries and keeps their base addresses in globals. When both open it initialises an empty list in the structure and returns it; otherwise it closes what was opened, frees the structure and returns zero.

name: unload_fonts_when_idle
description: Part of the disk font library: walks a list of font records, unloading and unlinking those whose count is not positive. When no records remain and the pending flag is clear, it closes the libraries, frees the structure and returns the stored value; otherwise it marks the structure as pending and returns zero.

name: close_libraries_when_idle
description: Part of the disk font library: when the pending flag is clear and the count is not positive, it closes two libraries, unlinks the structure from its list, frees it and returns the stored value. Otherwise it sets the pending bit and returns zero.

name: set_pending_flag_return_zero
description: Part of the disk font library: sets the top bit of the byte at offset 14 in the structure and returns zero.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Consists only of a return instruction and does nothing.

name: clear_pending_flag_and_count
description: Part of the disk font library: clears the top bit of the byte at offset 14 and increments a 16-bit counter at offset 38 in the structure.

name: decrement_count_run_close
description: Part of the disk font library: decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure. When it reaches zero with the pending bit set, it calls a library function through the table and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: score_font_match_difference
description: Part of the disk font library: scores how far two 8-entry font records differ. It starts from a scaled difference of their 16-bit fields plus 32767, returning minus 32767 when the first field is zero, then subtracts a weight from a global table for each bit that differs in two flag bytes.

name: load_and_install_disk_font
description: Part of the disk font library: searches the font list for the record that best matches the request, using a scoring routine, loads the chosen font segment from the FONTS directory and adds the font to the graphics font list. It releases locks, memory and libraries it used before returning the font handle, or zero on failure.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Part of the disk font library: copies a zero-terminated string from the source to the destination, including the terminator.

name: pass_args_at_string_end
description: Part of the disk font library: moves to the zero terminator of a string and passes the end pointer and the second argument to one more routine.

name: call_at_string_end
description: Part of the disk font library: moves a pointer to the zero terminator of a string and passes that end pointer to one more routine.

name: count_string_length
description: Part of the disk font library: returns the number of bytes before the zero terminator of a string.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Part of the disk font library: compares two zero-terminated strings character by character. It returns minus one when the first string is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when they are equal.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Part of the disk font library: compares two zero-terminated strings character by character. It returns minus one when the first string is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when they are equal.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Part of the disk font library: compares two zero-terminated strings character by character. It returns minus one when the first string is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when they are equal.

name: find_first_char_in_string
description: Part of the disk font library: scans a zero-terminated string for the first occurrence of the byte passed in, returning a pointer to it, or null if the string ends first.

name: find_first_char_in_string
description: Part of the disk font library: scans a zero-terminated string for the first occurrence of the byte passed in, returning a pointer to it, or null if the string ends first.

name: find_char_after_string_start
description: Part of the disk font library: starts one byte past the given position and scans forward for the byte in the data register, returning a pointer to its first match or null at the end of the string.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Part of the disk font library: finds the length of a zero-terminated string, then walks backwards from its end to the last occurrence of the given byte. It returns a pointer to that byte, or null when there is none.

name: skip_past_path_delimiter
description: Part of the disk font library: searches a string for a slash and, if none is found, for a colon. It returns a pointer just past the first delimiter found, or the original pointer when neither is present.

name: build_font_entry_buffer
description: Part of the disk font library: fills a buffer with font entry records taken from a list in memory and from the FONTS directory, as selected by flag bits. It returns how far the buffer overran, or zero when everything fitted.

name: build_font_entry_buffer
description: Part of the disk font library: fills a buffer with font entry records taken from a list in memory and from the FONTS directory, as selected by flag bits. It returns how far the buffer overran, or zero when everything fitted.

name: build_font_entry_buffer

name: scan_fonts_directory_entries
description: Part of the disk font library: locks the FONTS directory, examines its contents and allocates memory for the entries it finds. It returns the directory lock and buffer to the caller for further scanning.

name: collect_dot_font_entries
description: Part of the disk font library: loops over directory entries, skipping names without the dot-font suffix. For each matching entry it opens the file and records its size and flags in the buffer, and it returns how far the buffer overran, or zero.

name: build_font_entry_buffer
description: Part of the disk font library: fills a buffer with font entry records taken from a list in memory and from the FONTS directory, as selected by flag bits. It returns how far the buffer overran, or zero when everything fitted.

name: read_font_file_entries
description: Part of the disk font library: reads font file data through the library read call and writes an entry for each record found into the buffer. It returns the overrun count, or zero when the buffer fits.

name: finish_font_directory_scan
description: Part of the disk font library: steps through the examined directory entries, then unlocks the directory, frees the memory it allocated and returns the overrun count, or zero when the buffer fits.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Part of the disk font library: returns zero and does nothing else.

name: scan_dot_font_files
description: Part of the disk font library: locks the directory named by its argument and looks for files with the dot-font suffix. When one is found it allocates a table and records each matching font entry in it, then returns the table pointer, or null when nothing was recorded.

name: load_disk_font_table
description: Part of the disk font library: builds a table for a disk font. It allocates a memory block, fills in a header, a 16-bit count and an initial field, then copies font metric and control bytes from the input for each entry and updates the count.

name: free_block_from_stack_args
description: Part of the disk font library: reads a pointer from the caller's stack argument area and passes it, with the same value, to the memory-free wrapper.

name: forward_single_library_call
description: Part of the disk font library: calls one other routine and returns.

name: copy_fifteen_longwords_and_call
description: Copies fifteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the address register into the buffer passed on the stack, when that buffer is non-null. It then calls a routine through a pointer held in the A5 register.

name: patch_trackdisk_device_entry
description: Program entry point. It opens trackdisk.device by name and scans a memory area for a list of entries. When a size threshold is exceeded it disables interrupts, allocates a block, copies a region of words into it and adjusts a field. The decompiled output is partly unreadable, so the exact purpose is only partly recovered.

name: return_value_at_pointer
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored at the address held in the A4 register.

name: wait_fetch_and_reply_message
description: Finds the current task. If a field of the task is zero it waits on the task's port and fetches a message, and if a message was received it forbids task switching and replies to it. It returns zero.

name: wait_fetch_and_reply_message
description: Finds the current task. If a field of the task is zero it waits on the task's port and fetches a message, and if a message was received it forbids task switching and replies to it. It returns zero.

name: wait_fetch_and_reply_message
description: Program entry point. It finds the current task; if a field of the task is zero it waits on the task's port and fetches a message, and if a message was received it forbids task switching and replies to it before returning zero.

name: wait_for_frames_count
description: Waits for the number of display frames given in the data register, calling the graphics library's wait routine once per frame.

name: initialise_devices_and_run_main
description: Large setup routine, shown truncated. It opens and checks the libraries and devices named in its text, including diskfont, audio and timer, loads the BALL1 and BALL2 IFF images and the music file, checks for the required font file, and sets up the display, fonts and sprites. The rest of the routine is not visible in the output.

name: run_main_loop_section
description: Part of the main routine, shown truncated. It polls for messages inside a loop and makes many library calls. The rest of the routine is not visible in the output.

name: poll_messages_and_reply_loop
description: Part of the main routine, shown truncated. It polls for incoming messages in a loop, replies to them through the exec reply call, and makes a series of library calls. The remainder is not visible in the output.

name: blit_move_sprites_per_frame
description: Large routine, shown truncated. It copies memory and blits bitmaps through the graphics library, moves sprites and sets the raster, and handles messages with get and reply calls. Only part of its logic is visible.

name: update_display_state_loop
description: Resets a few state words and then runs a loop that calls graphics-library routines and updates a counter and display position on each pass. The decompiled body is longer than the instruction count recorded for it, and the output is truncated, so only part of the logic is described.

name: tail_into_display_update_code
description: A single-instruction entry whose decompiled body is the display update code that follows it. The output is truncated, so only a partial description is possible.

name: advance_counter_and_refresh_rows
description: Entry into the main display routine, shown truncated. It advances a counter, clamps a size computed from a structure field into a range, and runs an inner loop of library calls for each of three rows.

name: reset_display_counters_and_loop
description: Part of the main display routine, shown truncated. It clears several display counters and then enters the main loop, which refreshes the frame through library calls and checks a state word.

name: set_flag_enter_frame_loop
description: Short entry that sets one flag word and then continues into the main frame loop. The rest of the routine is truncated in the output.

name: scale_shift_enter_loop
description: Entry that, while a counter is below two, doubles a scale value and resets it to 41 when it reaches 40, then continues into the main frame loop. The rest of the routine is truncated in the output.

name: set_flag_enter_frame_loop
description: Short entry that sets one flag word and then continues into the main frame loop. The rest of the routine is truncated in the output.

name: remap_table_then_loop
description: Remaps each byte of a table: a value of five becomes zero, seven becomes three, eleven becomes two, and other values above four become ten. It then continues into the main frame loop, which is truncated in the output.

name: write_remapped_bytes_loop
description: Loops over a table of bytes, writing a replacement value for each entry chosen from its value (three for seven, two for eleven, ten for other large codes), and then continues into the frame loop. The output is truncated.

name: write_cycled_table_values
description: Walks a table of bytes, rewriting each one with a replacement code chosen from its value, such as seven becoming three and eleven becoming two, and then continues into the frame loop. The output is truncated.

name: remap_table_and_blit_rows
description: Remaps a table of bytes using the same value substitutions and calls the graphics blit routine for each row. The output is truncated, so the remaining logic is not visible.

name: set_two_flags_enter_loop
description: Sets two flag words and then continues into the main frame loop. The rest of the routine is truncated in the output.

name: rotate_source_pointer_loop
description: Chooses the next source pointer from a rotating set of four table entries, advancing through them as a counter moves on, and then continues into the main frame loop. The output is truncated.

name: select_next_source_pointer
description: Chooses the next source pointer from four table entries using a rotating counter, then continues into the frame loop. The output is truncated.

name: select_next_source_pointer
description: Chooses the next source pointer from four table entries using a rotating counter, then continues into the frame loop. The output is truncated.

name: select_next_source_pointer
description: Chooses the next source pointer from four table entries using a rotating counter, then continues into the frame loop. The output is truncated.

name: call_twice_then_frame_loop
description: Calls two routines and then continues into the main frame loop. The rest of the output is truncated.

name: decrement_scale_shift_loop
description: When a counter is not minus one, it decrements the counter, halves a scale value and sets a redraw flag, clearing an existing handle first if one is set. It then continues into the frame loop, which is truncated in the output.

name: set_minus_one_enter_loop
description: Sets one flag word to minus one and continues into the main frame loop. The rest of the routine is truncated in the output.

name: shutdown_devices_sprites_and_ports
description: Large routine, shown truncated. Its text includes the error messages for failing to allocate three sprites and to open audio.device, and its library calls release ports, devices, sprites, fonts, interrupt servers and windows. Only its frame loop prefix is visible in the output.

name: draw_title_text_and_sprites
description: Draws a short text string whose reference reads MEGA, using graphics library calls to set the drawing mode and position and to print the text, and moves sprites in the same pass. The shown body is short, so only these visible calls are described.

name: drain_message_port
description: Repeatedly takes messages from a port and replies to each one until the port is empty.

name: poll_messages_until_flagged
description: Takes messages from a port in a loop and replies to each. It records a flag when one message field has a set bit, or keeps a byte from another field, and it waits one display frame per cycle until the flag is set.

name: update_animated_position
description: Advances a bouncing position. It counts down timers, reverses direction at range limits, and when the position falls inside an allowed window it records it and updates a scaled offset.

name: forward_single_graphics_call
description: Makes one graphics library call and returns, with no other work of its own.

name: update_grid_cell_at_point
description: Looks up a grid cell from two coordinate values. When the cell holds a non-zero code, it updates the cell: code five is checked against a short pattern, other codes advance through a fixed cycle, and a counter is adjusted. A value is then bucketed into one of fourteen classes by thresholds.

name: update_grid_cell_at_point
description: Looks up a grid cell from two coordinate values. When the cell holds a non-zero code, it updates the cell: code five is checked against a short pattern, other codes advance through a fixed cycle, and a counter is adjusted. A value is then bucketed into one of fourteen classes by thresholds.

name: format_unsigned_decimal_digits
description: Writes an unsigned 16-bit value as decimal ASCII digits into the buffer at the address register, starting from the ten-thousands place and stopping after the last non-zero quotient.

name: format_unsigned_decimal_digits_var
description: Like its neighbour, writes a value as decimal ASCII digits, using a divisor taken from the second data register on each pass.

name: draw_score_board_text
description: Draws a series of rows while a counter is below a threshold, then builds the text ' Score:   Board: ' in memory and prints it with the text routine before returning.

name: wait_and_show_board_text
description: Loops until a computed value reaches a limit, then builds the text ' Score:   Board: ' in memory and prints it with the text routine before returning.

name: blit_cell_if_nonzero
description: Checks a grid cell from two state values. When the coordinates fall on a grid position and the cell holds a non-zero value, it calls a graphics routine.

name: forward_single_graphics_call
description: Makes one graphics library call and returns, with no other work of its own.

name: draw_sprite_table_entries
description: Walks a table of 8-byte entries, computes clamped horizontal positions from each entry and draws each one with a graphics blit call. At most six entries are drawn.

name: fade_palette_steps
description: Builds a palette for each of thirteen steps by scaling each colour component of a colour table by the step count over fifteen and adding a fixed offset. Each palette is loaded into the display and the routine waits between steps.

name: fade_palette_steps_down
description: Scales a colour table by a count stepping down from twelve to zero, loading each palette into the display and waiting between steps.

name: fade_palette_steps_up
description: Scales a colour table by a count rising from zero to fifteen, loading each palette into the display and waiting between steps, then sets a flag and returns.

name: fade_palette_from_fifteen_down
description: Scales a colour table by a count stepping down from fifteen to zero, loading each palette into the display and waiting between steps.

name: abort_pending_io_requests
description: Repeatedly calls the exec abort routine on an I/O request until it returns zero.

name: wait_for_io_request_completion
description: Repeatedly calls the exec wait routine on an I/O request until it returns zero.
